slides.headline: A battle near Pune decided the fate of an empire that had ruled for over a century.
The Battle of Khadki was fought November 5, 1817, near Pune.
slides.body: East India Company forces defeated the army of Peshwa Baji Rao II in a decisive early battle of the Third Anglo-Maratha War.

slides.headline: The defeat led directly to the fall of the Peshwa and British annexation of Pune.
slides.body: It marked the effective end of over a century of Maratha Empire rule in the region - one of the pivotal military turning points of early 19th-century Indian history.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: Understanding how power actually shifted in India's past is part of building clearly toward its future.
slides.body: Khadki is a reminder that the map of modern India was shaped by battles, treaties and negotiations long before 1947 - history worth knowing on its own terms.
